commits.subject: feat(picrep): support commutes with base change for finite modules (carrier bridge a)
commits.summary:
**Carrier bridge (a) for divzero.** support_baseChange_finite: for finite A-module M and A-algebra B, q in Supp_B(B tensor M) iff comap q in Supp_A M. Reviewer-directed (I-1722/I-1721), NOT a re-spelling: changes containing set from supp F to supp(g^*F), which rfl does not identify.

Proof: residue-field fibre criterion + cancelBaseChange twice (through extension kappa(p)->kappa(q)) + faithful flatness of a field extension. No flatness/noetherian hypothesis. Axiom-clean [propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound], lake env lean EXIT=0.
